testimonials.title: Sivam
testimonials.creator: iqode.tech@gmail.com
testimonials.bodyText: "My heartiest congratulations and sincere salutations to the Team on doing such an important and great job. Happy 5th Anniversary and I feel blessed to be part of your circle too. Your teachers are so dedicated and your products are so useful too. I recently checked out an American website that was offering a Sanskrit home learning CD course for US$450. The standard is not even 10% of what Vyoma offers. Congratulations. A very happy and satisfied student n client. Jai Siya Ram."

testimonials.title: Vasudevan Sripati
testimonials.creator: iqode.tech@gmail.com
testimonials.bodyText: "I have purchased few products of Vyoma Labs of which Ashtadhyayi and Shabdaroopasangraha are excellent. I am yet to use Sandhi and Samasa. I have wholeheartedly recommended these to concerned people. It would be very helpful if you make teacher-student and chanting mode CD on Amarakosha which I feel would be of great help for self-learning students. It would be of great use if you are able to put a stall at Samskrita Bharathi in Girinagar where it can reach a lot of people interested in Samskri

testimonials.title: Sanath Kumar
testimonials.creator: iqode.tech@gmail.com
testimonials.bodyText: "Firstly I would like to thank and congratulate Vyoma Labs for the wonderful work that you’re doing in preaching Sanskrit. I regularly watch vyoma’s Youtube videos and have also purchased vyoma’s sandhi and samasa cds. So many thanks for your work. In reference to wonderful work on surasaraswathi sabha front (Sringeri Sanskrit exams), specifically to truteeya, I have been benefited immensely through vyoma’s online e portal., I study the material online as I am unable to attend classes. Once agai

testimonials.title: Raj Acharya
testimonials.creator: iqode.tech@gmail.com
testimonials.bodyText: "I have studied tingantaprakaranam before. But now listening to ms. Somaya is such a pleasure to see how she explains the complex subject topic so clearly. I hope that she teaches kradant also. Thanks for this wonderful work."

testimonials.title: Iragavarapu Narasimhacharya
testimonials.creator: iqode.tech@gmail.com
testimonials.bodyText: "Dear Friend, praNamyA. Your programme is excellent.The teaching is clear.As I am 80 years old and as I have a little hearing impaired through-out I could not follow.Maheswara SutraaNi were clearly explained and I was able to listen to them well.My computer also is a little defective as it is an old one.I also lack in the skill to operate well. Any how,on the whole to judge,your performance is excellent"

testimonials.title: Sudha Raghuraman
testimonials.creator: iqode.tech@gmail.com
testimonials.bodyText: "Tuesdays & thursdays without Gita classes are unimaginable.we miss the divine atmosphere. I specially thank you for all your efforts.and your presentation with all the detailed notes.Iam taking down all the notes and as you say, daily i read the shlokas and stay in touch with the momentam. I consider myself blessed to have association with VSP. Thanking you and with kind regards"

testimonials.title: Late. Prof. M A Lakshmithathachar
testimonials.creator: iqode.tech@gmail.com
testimonials.bodyText: "हार्दानि अभिनन्दनानि चिरमभिवर्धनां संस्कृत श्रीः।" Vyoma Should stive to become a Virtual Sanskrit University as early as possible.

testimonials.title: Prof. Shrinivasa Varakhedi Ph.D
testimonials.creator: iqode.tech@gmail.com
testimonials.bodyText: The products developed by the Vyoma team has come out well. Concept videos, audios and animations are very informative. The products are highly recommended for students and teachers.

testimonials.title: Dr. M Jayaraman
testimonials.creator: iqode.tech@gmail.com
testimonials.bodyText: The field of Samskritam needs such pioneering ventures to reach out to the people of the world in this contemporary era, who are in search of knowledge. This is a commendable effort. Way to go!

testimonials.title: Braḥmaśrī  Kalaimamani  Dr. Udaiyalur Kalyanaraman
testimonials.creator: iqode.tech@gmail.com
testimonials.bodyText: Thanks to Vyoma’s Sanskrit e-learning tools, am enjoying the bhāva in each kṛti more than ever and this instills strong-bhakti in lakhs of listeners too… My heartfelt blessings to them

testimonials.title: Kum. Neha Anisetty
testimonials.creator: iqode.tech@gmail.com
testimonials.bodyText: The webinar sessions on the Bhagavad Gītā are helping me a lot in learning the Gītā. It has improved my pronunciation, concentration, memory, patience and discipline. It has helped my learning of Sanskrit language and Carnatic Vocal music.

testimonials.title: Lessons on Vedanta: Positive impact on my day to day interactions
testimonials.creator: iqode.tech@gmail.com
testimonials.bodyText: Thanks to Vyoma Labs, distance and language are no longer barriers to a spiritual seeker living outside India. I am grateful to all of you for your help with my spiritual journey, which has had a profound impact on my day to day interactions and activities as well.

testimonials.title: Experiencing prāṇāyāma benefits while Sanskrit chanting shlokas
testimonials.creator: iqode.tech@gmail.com
testimonials.bodyText: The link between chanting Sanskrit Shlokas and prāṇāyāma was mind-blowing. We experienced the power of chanting Sanskrit shlokas, we realize the benefits and we would spread this during our Yoga sessions
